text:
maria: Quick heads-up — we're kicking off a 2-week SI enablement pilot with IntegrateCo. Goals: instructor-led bootcamp, hands-on lab kits, marketplace listing prep, and a lightweight cert badge. Kickoff Wed 10am PT. Who can take HW + marketplace ownership?

alex: I can run the labs and instructor ops. Need HW inventory + test images. @kevin can you drop the marketplace checklist? :+1:

kevin: Sharing checklist now — will DM the full PDF but highlights: security questionnaire, AMI/container scan, marketplace metadata, and partner legal sign-off. Link (draft): https://redwood.internal/marketplace-checklist

sophie: I'll own instructor training and the agenda. Proposed cadence: 3 x 90m live sessions + 2 async lab exercises. Draft agenda in the doc: Day1 arch & model choices, Day2 integration + SDK, Day3 ops, rollouts & troubleshooting.

jamal: Eng will produce a reference AMI and a docker image with model + kv-cache example. ETA Monday EOD. Also building a tiny loadgen for perf baselines.

maria: Nice. For the certification badge — thinking of 3 checkpoints: deploy a sample app, pass a perf smoke (p95 < Xms), and complete a short ops drill (failover). Should be lightweight and automatable.

alex: Agree on automation. We can wire the checkpoints into the existing eval harness (repo: github.com/redwood/evals). If they pass, add automatic badge issuance.

kevin: Marketplace approvals will require the tested AMI + security attestation. If we list IntegrateCo as an "authorized SI" in the listing we can expedite review — legal + security need to OK that. I'll loop in legal now.

sophie: Logistics question — can we get 10 physical lab kits (GPU + dongles) to ship to SIs for hands-on? That would make instructor sessions smoother.

maria: Partner ops confirmed $5k in pilot credits for shipping; customs may still be on us. @jamal do we have budget for 10 kits from Eng side or should we use partner credits?

jamal: 10 kits looks feasible. HW partner lead time ~2 weeks. Need a PO by Friday to hit pilot start. I'll open the PO and sync with HW vendor.

maria: Great — action items I have: organize kickoff invite, coordinate partner comms, and track PO.

alex: Action: draft lab repo + instructor notes by Monday.

sophie: Action: finalize agenda + train-the-trainer script, prep slide deck.

kevin: Action: start marketplace intake form and tag as "pilot fast-track".

jamal: Action: build AMI + loadgen, confirm shipping address format for kits.

deploy-bot: Document published: si-pilot-readiness-v1.pdf (internal) — https://redwood.docs/si-pilot-readiness-v1 — :page_facing_up:

maria: Thanks all. Wed 10am PT kickoff calendar sent. Please add blockers in the doc and mark any must-haves.

alex: LGTM — will add lab checklist.

sophie: Adding instructor runbook now. :rocket:

kevin: I'll update when legal replies.

jamal: PO created (PO-4521), ETA on kits updated in the doc.

maria: Perfect — marking this thread as the single source for pilot readiness updates. Ping here for urgent items.
